clf_control.text:
[VERSE 1]  
I wanted to be someone else,  
To live a life without the pain,  
But every step I took,  
Was just a shadow of what I had.  
Regrets like ghosts that haunt the night,  
They whisper in the dark, "You could’ve..."  
I wish I had chosen differently,  
But time doesn’t rewind, it just moves on.

***  

[VERSE 2]  
I held on to the past like a wound,  
Trying to heal with memories that hurt.  
The choices I made, they’re all so clear,  
Now I see the mistakes I’ve made.  
I wish I had listened to my heart,  
Instead of chasing what I thought I wanted.  
The love I lost, the dreams I let go,  
All of them are pieces of my soul.

***  

[VERSE 3]  
I’ve learned that regret isn’t a sin,  
It’s just a part of the journey I’ve taken.  
It teaches me to be more mindful,  
To cherish the moments that I’ve had.  
Though I may have made mistakes,  
I’m still here, still learning and growing.  
Regrets are a part of me,  
And I’m okay with that.

***  

[OUTRO]  
So here’s to the regrets I’ve faced,  
To the lessons I’ve learned and the scars I’ve made.  
I’m not perfect, I’m not flawless,  
But I’m still me, and that’s what matters most.
